title: BlackFlare — Keep awake, notify Claude/Codex finishes
excerpt: BlackFlare — a menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex. Keep your Mac awake during long runs, get notified when tasks finish, switch defaults, track usage.
content_html:
macOS menu bar app · Claude Code & Codex

Let your agents run.
Touch some grass.

BlackFlare keeps your Mac awake while Claude or Codex runs, pings you the moment a task finishes or needs you — on your Mac, Telegram, or Slack. Tune your defaults and track your usage right from the menu bar. On-device. Private.

Requires macOS 13 or later · Universal (Apple silicon & Intel)

The gap between "running" and "done"

You kick off a long task and step away. Your Mac dozes off and the whole run stalls halfway. Or it finishes — or sits waiting for your input — and you don't notice for an hour. BlackFlare closes every one of those gaps.

  • Terminal / CLI
  • VS Code
  • JetBrains
  • Claude Code
  • Codex

Long task? Your Mac stays up.

A sleeping Mac is a stalled agent. While a Claude or Codex session is running, BlackFlare keeps your Mac awake — so overnight refactors and marathon test runs never pause halfway. The moment the session ends, normal sleep resumes on its own.

Know the instant it needs you

The moment Claude or Codex is waiting for input — or finishes a task — BlackFlare sends you a notification. Every session counts: the CLI in your terminal and agents running inside VS Code or JetBrains.

On your Mac. Or your phone.

Route notifications to Telegram or Slack and go touch some grass while your agents work. Flip on "only when away" and BlackFlare stays quiet at your desk — reaching your phone only once you've actually stepped out.

Set the defaults. Ship faster.

Pick your default model, permission mode, effort level, and thinking mode right from the menu bar. BlackFlare applies them to your next session — no flags to remember, no config files to hand-edit.

See your limits before you hit them

Your Claude and Codex usage lives in the menu — and right in the menu bar icon. Track each model on its own, keep an eye on extra usage, and get a heads-up the moment you cross a threshold you set. No more mid-task surprises.

Private by design. Actually.

BlackFlare asks for exactly one thing: read-only Keychain access to your Claude token, used only to show your exact usage. That token is never written or sent anywhere but Anthropic. No accounts, no analytics, no telemetry — BlackFlare collects nothing about you. Ever.

  • ✓ Runs entirely on-device
  • ✓ Read-only Keychain access
  • ✓ Token only ever reaches Anthropic
  • ✓ Zero telemetry, zero accounts

Up and running in a minute

Three steps, then go be human

  1. 1

    Install

    Open and drag it to Applications. From there it lives quietly in your menu bar.

  2. 2

    Grant Permissions

    Two gentle asks: notifications, so it can tap you on the shoulder, and Keychain — read-only — to read your usage limits. Nothing more, ever.

  3. 3

    Walk away

    Start a session and go enjoy life. BlackFlare keeps watch, and pings you when it matters.

Thoughtful down to the last toggle

Built like a native Mac app should be

Questions, answered

Frequently asked

Does it work with the CLI and with IDEs?

Yes. BlackFlare watches Claude Code and Codex sessions whether they run in your terminal or inside VS Code and JetBrains IDEs.

Which AI tools are supported?

Claude Code and Codex — both notifications and usage, side by side in the same menu.

Where does my token go?

Nowhere new. BlackFlare reads your Claude token from the macOS Keychain (read-only) to show your exact usage. It is never written or transmitted anywhere except Anthropic.

Do you collect any of my data?

No. No accounts, no analytics, no telemetry. Everything runs on your Mac.

Can it notify my phone?

Yes — via Telegram or Slack, with an "only when away" mode so you're not pinged twice while you're sitting at your desk.

Will it keep my Mac from sleeping?

Only while a session is running, so long tasks don't stall. Normal sleep behavior resumes automatically the moment the session ends.

What do I need to run it?

A Mac on macOS 13 or later. It's a universal build for both Apple silicon and Intel.

让你的特工跑起来。触摸一些草。

当 Claude 或 Codex 运行时，BlackFlare 可以让您的 Mac 保持唤醒状态，并在任务完成或需要您时向您发出 ping 信号（在您的 Mac、Telegram 或 Slack 上）。 直接从菜单栏调整您的默认设置并跟踪您的使用情况。 设备上。 私人的。

需要 macOS 13 或更高版本·通用（Apple 芯片和英特尔）

“运行”和“完成”之间的差距

你开始一项漫长的任务然后走开。 您的 Mac 打瞌睡，整个运行过程中途停止。 或者它完成了——或者等待你的输入——而你一个小时都没有注意到。 BlackFlare 弥补了所有这些差距。

  • VS代码
  • 捷脑公司
  • 克劳德·科德

任务长吗？ 您的 Mac 保持开机状态。

休眠的 Mac 是一个停滞的代理。 当 Claude 或 Codex 会话运行时，BlackFlare 会让您的 Mac 保持唤醒状态 - 因此通宵重构和马拉松测试运行永远不会中途暂停。 会话结束后，正常睡眠会自行恢复。

知道它需要你的那一刻

当 Claude 或 Codex 等待输入或完成任务时，BlackFlare 会向您发送通知。 每个会话都很重要：终端中的 CLI 以及在 VS Code 或 JetBrains 内运行的代理。

在你的 Mac 上。 或者你的手机。

将通知发送到 Telegram 或 Slack，并在您的客服人员工作时去摸草。 “仅在离开时”打开，BlackFlare 就会在您的办公桌前保持安静 - 仅在您真正走出去后才拿起手机。

设置默认值。 发货更快。

直接从菜单栏中选择默认模型、权限模式、工作量级别和思维模式。 BlackFlare 将它们应用到您的下一个会话中 — 无需记住任何标志，无需手动编辑配置文件。

问题，已解答

常见问题

Does it work with the CLI and with IDEs?

是的。 BlackFlare 会监视 Claude Code 和 Codex 会话，无论它们是在终端中运行还是在 VS Code 和 JetBrains IDE 中运行。

Which AI tools are supported?

Claude Code 和 Codex — 通知和使用，并排在同一菜单中。

Where does my token go?

没有什么新的地方。 BlackFlare 从 macOS 钥匙串（只读）读取您的 Claude 令牌，以显示您的确切用法。 除了人择之外，它从未在任何地方被书写或传播。

Do you collect any of my data?

不。没有账户，没有分析，没有遥测。 一切都在您的 Mac 上运行。

Can it notify my phone?

是的 - 通过 Telegram 或 Slack，具有“仅在离开时”模式，这样当您坐在办公桌前时就不会被两次 ping 到。

Will it keep my Mac from sleeping?

仅当会话运行时，长任务才不会停止。 会话结束后，正常睡眠行为会自动恢复。

What do I need to run it?

macOS 13 或更高版本的 Mac。 它是苹果芯片和英特尔芯片的通用构建。
